release_notes:
Add a server-side safety net for Stripe payment confirmations

Credits were applied only when a customer's browser made it back to
our site after paying through Stripe. If that final step didn't
complete -- a closed tab, a lost connection, an app that didn't
return control to the browser -- the payment succeeded on Stripe's
side but credits were never added, with no way for us to find out.

Stripe can now notify us directly once a payment is confirmed, so
credits are applied even if the browser never returns. This runs
alongside the existing flow rather than replacing it, with a guard
in place so a payment is never credited twice.
